title: IMD National Bulletin No. 3 (BOB/10/2026, 15:00 IST 15 Nov 2026) puts Andhra Pradesh and adjoining south Odisha coasts on a pre-cyclone watch (first of IMD's four warning stages); depression over SE Bay of Bengal forecast to become a cyclonic storm 16 Nov, severe cyclonic storm 17 Nov, then move northwest towards the Andhra Pradesh coast; very severe cyclonic storm over the sea by 18-19 Nov, 120-130 km/h gusting to 145 km/h at 11:30 IST 19 Nov (16.2N/84.7E); no landfall point named, RSMC says models diverge; isolated extremely heavy rain (>=21 cm) north coastal Andhra 19-20 Nov, heavy to very heavy north TN/Puducherry 18-19 Nov, Odisha 19-21 Nov; fishermen to return by 15 Nov. Next name on the list: Akvan, after Arnab and Murasu.
